text:
Maya: quick question: i'm prototyping an ephemeral token exchange for service accounts. idea is client calls /exchange with org+project context -> gets short-lived JWT with claims (project, route). want to use the token claim for routing/quota rather than trusting the incoming origin header. anyone seen pitfalls?
Ben: did something similar on staging. main trap is attribution mismatch for billing when tokens are minted without project. we ended up with many requests falling back to origin header and billing noise.
Raj: can we make the exchange flow mandatory for console-created tokens and optional for raw API keys? if a token has project claim, treat it authoritative. else mark attribution as low confidence.
Claire: agree on confidence flags. console UX should surface attribution_confidence per-route (High/Low) and allow sampling of low-confidence requests. PM will want clear wording.
Maya: latency concern: extra round-trip to exchange. could we allow server-side SDKs to do exchange transparently? also want telemetry to know who adopted it.
Ben: we added metrics: auth.exchange.requests, auth.exchange.success, auth.exchange.latency_ms, auth.no_project.fallback. grafana query: sum(rate(auth_exchange_success[5m])) by (env).
Raj: security: prevent cross-project replay. include aud claim like "auth-proxy:<route>" and short TTL (30s-5m). Also sign with rotating key so long-lived tokens can't mint ephemeral ones without consent.
Claire: quota enforcement: if token has project claim, use that for quota checks. if not present, mark request unverified and apply stricter throttling and lower burst allowance. make this visible in quota logs.
Maya: good. rollout strategy? propose feature flag `auth.exchange_required` per env + canary. start opt-in, then enforce for new console tokens, then flip flag for API surface.
Ben: add fallback model: when exchange failures spike, route to a lower-cost model variant instead of failing hard. also add alerting on auth.no_project.fallback rising >10% for 5m.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for auth-proxy/exchange v1 -> hosts: auth-proxy-2/3/4. watching metrics: auth_exchange_success, auth_exchange.latency_ms, auth_no_project_fallback.
Maya: can someone paste the dashboard snippet? want it in the canary playbook.
Ben: pasted to thread: http://grafana.company/d/abc123/auth-exchange?orgId=1  Query: sum(rate(auth_exchange_success[5m])) by (env) and sum(rate(auth_no_project_fallback[5m])) by (env)
Claire: i'll mock up the console column for attribution confidence and a sampling toggle, then loop in UX/PM.
Maya: thanks all. i'll open a PR for the exchange endpoint with telemetry counters and a docs note about using exchange to get project-level billing. keeping this thread for follow-ups and rollout checklist.
